test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an impact of globalisation on India's trade?

options.text: It has increased the self-reliance and autonomy of trade
It has reduced the dependency on foreign markets
It has reduced the competition and challenges of trade
It has increased the volume and diversity of trade

solution:
The correct answer is __**It has increased the volume and diversity of trade**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Globalization has significantly increased the volume of India's trade, with both exports and imports seeing substantial growth.
 
• It has diversified the range of products that India trades, including technology, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and services.
 
• India's trade partners have expanded globally, including countries from Asia, Europe, and the Americas, enhancing market access.
 
• The integration into the global economy has led to more competitive pricing and improved quality of products.
 
• India has become an important player in global value chains, contributing to various stages of production and distribution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Globalization:**

 
 
• It refers to the process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.
 
• Globalization is driven by international trade, investment, and information technology.
 
 
 
• **Trade Liberalization:**
 
 
• The removal or reduction of restrictions or barriers on the free exchange of goods between nations.
 
• It includes lowering tariffs, removing quotas, and reducing government regulations.
 
 
 
• **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI):**
 
 
• An investment made by a firm or individual in one country into business interests located in another country.
 
• FDI plays a crucial role in the globalization of production and trade.
 
 
 
• **Export-Import Policy of India:**
 
 
• It governs the export and import of goods and services.
 
• Aims to enhance the exports to enable the country to achieve a favorable balance of trade.
 
 
 
• **World Trade Organization (WTO):**
 
 
• An intergovernmental organization that regulates international trade.
 
• India is a member of the WTO, which helps in negotiating trade agreements and resolving trade disputes.
